slides.h: If Delhi food were people in your group chat

slides.p: Says “just a light lunch” and orders the heaviest thing. Says yes to everything, then sleeps through the plan.
Gets along with everyone and fits into any plan. Nobody has ever asked “do we have to invite them?”
Reliable, polite, loved by everyone’s parents. Never starts a fight, and never starts a conversation either.
Overpacks and overfeeds. “Have you eaten?” is the first thing they say and the last.
No patience and a lot of energy. Says “one more” and means five.
Promises “five minutes” and takes two hours. By the end, you know everyone’s life story.
